checks: A concise real Prompt excerpt is visible before the full Prompt disclosure.
Prompt preview and version editor disclosures start collapsed.
Only selected factual detail fields are editable.
Opening the shared overlay locks the page background.
Production hides the variant selector while the catalog has no real variants.
Keep/remove/replace intent becomes a separate modified Prompt.
Free text is retained without changing the catalog Prompt.
Prompt edits do not alter Artwork facts or the real downloadable PNG bytes.
Language switching updates prompt language and labels while retaining edit choices and free text.
A pending partner uses the shared bilingual detail, states its review status, hides nonexistent variants, and downloads the real local PNG.
A delayed English Prompt cannot overwrite a newer Chinese selection while a detail is opening.
An image-load failure leaves the verified Prompt usable and retries the same registered original.
Download validation failures remain visible and are not reported as successful.
Clipboard denial exposes the complete selectable Prompt and a manual ChatGPT link without attaching or sending an image.
A failed variant load leaves the previous successful version selected and emits no route update.
Changing language during a pending variant keeps the previous successful Artwork selected.
A verified variant with a delayed stale English Prompt commits the current Chinese Prompt, image, version and callback atomically, then clears the prior draft.
The overlay traps focus, delegates Escape, unlocks page content and restores the invoking control.
A native dialog close event delegates to the app shell and releases background inert state.
The in-dialog language control updates the real app Prompt while preserving unsaved choices and exact free text.
